scope: Read every nonretail paragraph and its own-date cited headline metadata; manually checked facts, companies, preview versus outcome, release timing, numerical direction and timeframe; checked all quoted market figures against own card and ran verifier. Retail keys excluded.

findings.finding: The China GDP sentence called 4.6% a quarterly growth reading, ambiguously implying quarter-on-quarter growth; rewritten to report growth for the third quarter without that implication.
Several market levels needed explicit currency or index units; XLP phrasing implied investor rotation from price evidence; the XLK Alphabet statement needed a citation in its own paragraph.

The November 3 Blackstone talks report was framed as a still-pending definitive-agreement catalyst. Narrowed to explicit dated historical attribution and transaction-valuation tests; no later-feed evidence imported.
